entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order from a couple of months ago. I bought a pair of your cycling shoes, and I need to return them.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Lace cycling shoes, delivered on October 16th. Can I ask what the issue is with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the fit. I've taken them on a few rides, adjusted the cleats every which way, but they just keep giving me terrible blisters on my heels. They're just not working for my feet.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let me check the return eligibility for you.
Okay, I've reviewed your order and our policy. It looks like you're well within our 90-day return window for standard items. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

That's great, I appreciate you approving the refund. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I'm a bit disappointed these didn't work out. Since I had such a poor experience with them, is there any chance of getting a small discount code for my next purchase? I'd like to try a different model.

I understand completely. We definitely value your loyalty, and I apologize again for the trouble with the blisters. As you're a VIP member, I can certainly do something for you. In addition to the full refund for the cycling shoes, I've just added a $25 credit to your account. You can use that on any future order.
Oh, a $25 credit is perfect. That's very helpful. Thank you, Charlie, I really appreciate you taking care of that for me.

You are very welcome. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. Just pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
